above_bot: ARCHON's role is below this member's highest role, so it can't act on them.
target_self: You can't do that to yourself.
target_me: ARCHON can't do that to itself.
target_owner: The server owner can't be moderated.
target_above_actor: This member's highest role is at or above yours.
target_above_bot: ARCHON's role is below this member's highest role. Move ARCHON's role higher in Server Settings > Roles.
no_perm: You need the {perm} permission for this.
not_member: That person isn't in this server.
ban_confirm_text: They are removed from the server and can't come back until they are unbanned.
unban_dm_rejoin: You can join again with the button below.
expired: This confirmation has expired. Run the command again.
not_yours: Only the moderator who started this can use these buttons.
invite_set: Unbanned members will get this invite: {invite}
invite_invalid: That isn't a Discord invite link. Use one like discord.gg/abc123.
invite_none: No rejoin invite is set, so unbanned members get no button to come back. Set one with /ban setinvite.
mute_bad_duration: Use a duration like 10m, 2h or 3d, between 1 minute and 28 days.
already_muted: Already timed out until {until}. Remove it first with /mute remove to change it.
mute_admin: Members with the Administrator permission can't be timed out.
warn_auto_failed: {count} active warnings, but the automatic {action} couldn't be applied: {why}
warn_not_found: There is no warning with that ID in this server.
clear_none: Nothing to delete: the messages are pinned, older than 14 days, or not from that member.
slow_bad: Use a duration like 5s, 30s, 2m or 1h (up to 6 hours), or off.
